Also Toonbuck Toora, Edcel Bar Gan [sic], Po Nudo&hellip; Do you want me to go on?|Chancellor Valorum and Senator Palpatine, on the former's [[Yinchorri embargo act]]|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The '''Ryloth Senatorial Delegation''' was a body of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] who represented [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and the other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The delegation consisted of a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and their [[Aide/Legends|aides]], although sometimes it was led by two co-senators. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|shut down]] by order of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and the Rylothean delegation was disbanded along with all the others.

==Organization==
[[File:OrnFreeTaa_TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|The Twi'lek senator Taa with two of his female aides]]
The Ryloth Senatorial Delegation sat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the legislative and executive branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its members represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and the other worlds contained within the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was apartised by [[Sector/Legends|sectorial]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]].</ref> It occupied a [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|rotunda]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and was led by one<ref name="cod" /> or up to three [[Senator/Legends|senators]],<ref name="DP" /> with the help of their [[Senatorial aide|aides]]<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> In the last decades of the Republic, all members of the delegation were [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], the native inhabitants of Ryloth.<ref name="DP" /> The heads of the delegation tended to be corpulent males<ref name="t4" /><ref name="DP" /> and often employed female assistants who were considered attractive.<ref name="DBOrn">{{DB|character|ornfreetaa|Taa, Orn Free}}</ref> This was seen as a badge of prestige and was customary within the male-dominated Twi'lek culture.<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|groups|twileks|Twi'leks}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Twilek_aidem.jpg|thumb|One of Orn Free Taa's aides around 32 BBY]]
{{Quote|The Senate recognizes Senator Orn Free Taa of Ryloth.|Mas Amedda|<ref name="DP" />}}
By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Ryloth delegation had three Twi'lek co-senators: [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Connus Trell]], and [[Chom Frey Kaa]]. That year, the whole group opposed the [[Yinchorri embargo act]] proposed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="DP" /> At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Senator Taa had three consorts: a [[Rutian/Legends|blue-skinned]] female named [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]], a pallid [[Unidentified pasty-skinned male Twi'lek|male assistant]] and a [[Lethan/Legends|red-skinned]] a [[Orn Free Taa's Twi'lek aide|female aide]]. He also had a protocol droid in his possession.<ref name="TPMIG" />

[[32 BBY/Legends|One year later]], the Ryloth group endorsed the candidacy of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], head of the [[Naboo Senatorial Delegation]], during the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|chancery election]] to replace Valorum.<ref name="DP" /> Shortly after the ascension of Palpatine to chancellorship, Connus Trell was killed by the bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="BH" /> and Kaa was brought up on corruption charges and arrested in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="t4" />

At some point during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Senator Taa's red-skinned consort was replaced by the emerald green [[Supi/Legends|Supi]].<ref name="DBSupi">{{DB|character|supi|Supi}}</ref> In the wake of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic was turned into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with the old congress becoming the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, [[0 BBY/Legends|nineteen years later]], that new assembly was officially [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanded]], and the Ryloth group disappeared along with all the other delegations.<ref name="ANH" />
